ayahOccurrences.text: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine plural (form IV) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُهْطِعِينَ is in the derivative form: مُهْطِعِين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
هـ/ط/ع   h–ṭ–ʿ to come rushing in fear, to stretch the neck and head in agitation, to transfix the eyes in horror, to cower in fear; a wide road. Of this root, مُهْطِعِين muhṭiʿın occurs 3 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُهْطِعِين muhṭiʿın [pl. of act. part. مُهْطِعٌ muhṭiʿ] mindlessly rushing with outstretched necks, hastening in anxiety

(54:8) مُهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ rushing with outstretched necks towards the Summoner, the disbelievers saying ‘This is a hard day.’
